supersedes_for_current_recommendation: simulation_plan_20261126; retained as historical proposal, not deleted
primary_questions: Obstacle-motion prediction versus zero obstacle velocity under otherwise identical navigation layers
Incremental CBF, speed-reference and lateral-reference effects with a common scan guard
Frozen identified setpoint-tracking model versus direct rate integration with online compensation disabled in both
Multistep versus N=1 using the same augmented model, limits, reference generator and cost convention
Bias estimation by TCP integral 2x2 design, with activation exposure reported
Moving versus stop-before-approach using the same WB-MPC
Whole-body predictive configuration versus adapted external reactive whole-body QP
Held-out-layout end-to-end task completion and efficiency
excluded_from_main_comparisons: network architecture ablation for the pretrained Mask R-CNN
queued-command prediction as an independently claimed ablation
engineering_prerequisites: Check time alignment, state/setpoint reporting, interfaces and guards before test; no dedicated formal fault-injection group is required.

nav_shared_conditions.guard: identical raw scan guard ON in all core navigation methods and ablations
nav_shared_conditions.limits: same norm translation cap, yaw cap, wheel limits and command change limits
nav_shared_conditions.inputs: same sensor availability and case geometry, route and external obstacle motion
nav_shared_conditions.no_prediction_variant: Retain tracker associations and current geometry; set obstacle velocity to zero in BOTH reference candidates and CBF.
nav_shared_conditions.caveat: Ablation effects are conditional on the common guard. Report intervention exposure if collisions are masked by that guard.
nav_shared_conditions.rpp: Retained as a common reference with forward/yaw commands; acknowledge lateral capability difference.

local_shared_conditions.target_source: Each case uses one shared initial RGB-D target/geometry packet; mechanism references subsequently use the same geometry model. Save the packet with its timestamp and frame transforms.
local_shared_conditions.stop_before_approach: Reach base operation pose and settle before arm unfold, approach and grasp. Base may coordinate during door/drawer mechanism motion.
local_shared_conditions.external_baseline: Adapt published Holistic reactive QP, document position-interface adapter and shared limits; do not label it an exact reproduction or a deployed controller before implementation.
local_shared_conditions.contact: Keep existing frozen contact/attachment configuration identical across methods. No new contact-model development is required by this plan. Limit claims to capabilities actually simulated.
local_shared_conditions.model_contrast: Augmented model with frozen identified bias and no TCP integral versus direct integration with no online model adaptation or TCP integral. This contrasts model assumptions, not one scalar coefficient.
local_shared_conditions.compensation_factorial: Full, fixed bias, no integral, fixed bias plus no integral. Fixed bias retains the common identified initial value; report each gate activation duration.
local_shared_conditions.unmodified_geometry_metric: Use uncompensated task targets for primary TCP and task success evaluation.

horizon_selection: Choose N_star on separate validation cases before test; fix weights, dt, terminal matrix and tuning convention. Compare with N=1 in W2; optional H1 supplies the other two multistep choices. Stage cost extent and terminal time still differ.

model_collection.window_leakage: Do not mix windows of the same recording into train and test.

house_test.walkers: pre-saved external trajectories and fixed interaction rules
house_test.task: open door, traverse, cylinder and marker storage, close drawer, return traverse and close door, return to start

S1.condition: Make base-selection cost an independent contribution
S1.change: Only rank among the same feasible candidates; nearest feasible base comparator

K1.condition: Claim an independent benefit of the door hard pose tube

H1.condition: Need the full N in {1,5,10,20} sensitivity curve
H1.change: Other two multistep horizons; reuse N_star and N=1

statistics.unit: paired saved scenario seed, never control ticks or overlapping windows
statistics.counts: Initial workload budget; use development variability to freeze counts before test. No success-conditional supplementation.
statistics.outcomes: All attempts retain success/failure; time comparisons report paired-both-success n and conditional selection.
statistics.intervals: Paired/cluster intervals at case level and success intervals, with layout/task stratification.
statistics.contrasts: Prespecify primary endpoints and comparisons; handle multiple comparisons.
statistics.null_results: Report inactive or ineffective modules without selecting different test cases after seeing results.

reuse_requirements: same initial state and motion profile
same target packet and geometry model
ordering: Randomize within shared case blocks including reused full-method trials; rank is precomputed in CSV. Execute optional trials in the same frozen cohort or rerun their references if conditions change.
runtime: Use one common fixed pacing condition within a comparison; measure simulation task time and host computation time separately without a pacing sweep.
execution: Planning artifacts only. No simulator, controller, ROS launch or training is executed.
